seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Davis, California for 2026 including Winters: 8 family events, 3 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Davis celebrates with a downtown Candlelight Parade led by Santa, a children's market run by young sellers and a Nutcracker danced by local kids.
celebrates: The City of Davis leads the season with the Downtown Candlelight Parade, Tree Lighting and Winter Wonderland, where Santa and Mrs. Claus lead a parade from the Davis Food Co-op lot to the E Street Plaza and the council lights the community tree. City Parks and Community Services adds the Children's Holiday Market in Central Park, where kids ages 7 to 16 run their own booths, and the Davis Children's Nutcracker with a cast of local children. The Davis Odd Fellows Lodge serves pancakes with Santa, and nearby Winters holds its Tractor Parade. Davis Sings adds a free Family-Friendly Holiday Concert with the Davis Chorale and Davis Youth Choir at Davis Community Church on December 5.
lastyear: Last December the City of Davis held its 44th annual Candlelight Parade and Winter Wonderland on Thursday, December 4, 2025, according to Visit Yolo County. The Odd Fellows Lodge hosted its Breakfast with Santa the same month, and the city's 2025 Children's Market drew families to Central Park, where photos show kids selling handmade felt bags and keychains next to a vintage fire truck dressed with lights.
facts: The Davis Odd Fellows Lodge says it has about 400 members, making it the largest Odd Fellows Lodge in the world, and the hall has stood on Second Street since 1955. The lodge's Breakfast with Santa began in 2005 and marks its 19th year in 2026. The Davis Children's Nutcracker is in its 49th production and the city plans a 50th anniversary show next year.
trains: Davis does not run its own Santa train, but the River Fox Train in nearby West Sacramento runs a one hour Magical Christmas Train from Elkhorn Station through the Yolo countryside from November 27 to December 24, 2026, with Santa visiting every car. The Sacramento page also covers the Polar Express train ride at the California State Railroad Museum.

faq: What is the biggest Christmas event in Davis?

The City of Davis Candlelight Parade, Tree Lighting and Winter Wonderland on Thursday, December 3, 2026 is the main community night. Santa and Mrs. Claus lead a parade at 6 pm, the tree lights at 6:30 pm and G Street fills with music, snow fall and photos with Santa. The city also lists free horse and carriage rides.
Where can kids meet Santa in Davis?

Santa and Mrs. Claus lead the Candlelight Parade and pose for photos on an antique fire engine afterward. They are also at the Children's Holiday Market in Central Park on December 5, and Santa joins families for Breakfast with Santa at the Odd Fellows Lodge on December 12. Each event page has the details.
Are there free Christmas events in Davis?

The Candlelight Parade is a free city event with free carriage rides, and the Winters Tractor Parade is free. Breakfast with Santa and the Children's Nutcracker are ticketed, and the Children's Holiday Market does not print a price.
Is there a Christmas train near Davis?

Yes. River Fox Train in West Sacramento runs the Magical Christmas Train from November 27 to December 24, 2026. The ride lasts about an hour and Santa visits each car. See the West Sacramento page for the listing.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Davis for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 3 (Davis Candlelight Parade, Tree Lighting and Winter Wonderland) through December 13 (The Davis Children's Nutcracker), with the Children's Holiday Market (December 5), the Davis Sings Family-Friendly Holiday Concert (December 5), the Winters Holiday Tractor Parade (December 5), Christmas Down on the Farm (December 12) and Breakfast with Santa (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Davis

  • 7 Christmas events for kids in Davis
  • 2 free events: the Candlelight Parade and the Winters Tractor Parade
  • Meet Santa: the Candlelight Parade, the Children's Holiday Market, Breakfast with Santa at the Odd Fellows Lodge
  • Parades and tree lightings: Candlelight Parade (December 3) and Winters Tractor Parade (December 5)
  • Shows: The Davis Children's Nutcracker (December 9 to 13)
  • Season: December 3 to December 13, plus the Davis Food Co-op Christmas Eve meal

Planning a bigger day out? Davis families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Sacramento, which covers the Polar Express train ride at the California State Railroad Museum, Theatre of Lights and the Nutcracker.
